chunks: And I declared to them in public and I concealed to them in private.
ai.seo_question: How did Prophet Noah call his people to Islam according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the comprehensive nature of Noah's (peace be upon him) da'wah, demonstrating his patience and strategic use of both public proclamation and private counsel to address different levels of understanding among his people. This dual approach underscores the Islamic principle of tailoring communication to the audience, a method often cited by scholars to illustrate the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) own engagement with the Quraysh. It serves as a model for believers to persist in inviting others to faith despite initial rejection or indifference.
